title: 第549章 清萍出鞘圣影欲临第548章 截天镇劫金仙危圣念压岛候碧游
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
金鳌岛前，四海死寂。
玉清圣念横贯九天，无形无质的至高威压镇压整片海天，冻结阵纹、凝滞仙风、镇住万仙。方才即将收拢的截教大阵悬停半空，杀机尽数锁死，再难落下半分。
元始天尊一缕神念破空降临，虚空中缓缓凝出一道淡漠圣影，立身云海之巅，恰好挡在阐教十二金仙身前。
这道身影并不完整，无具体形貌、无磅礴威压外泄，却自带玉清正统、玄门至高的道韵层级，只需静静伫立，便压得整片金鳌岛道场微微震颤。
他先是抬眸，淡淡扫视前方那尊通体炽亮的截天巨像，目光掠过层层碧色圣芒，最终落向沉寂无声的碧游宫深处。
没有即刻动怒，没有骤然发难，却自带尘埃落定的强势姿态。
今日此行，不是随意问责，是要把阐截两教积攒多年的道统分歧、弟子归属、天意对错，彻底掰扯分明，定下无可辩驳的结局。
下方，十二金仙垂首而立，尽数沉默。
此前被截天华光洗去劫火、清醒心神之后，他们早已明白自身行径出格越界，理亏在先。
可圣人神念降临的瞬间，心底那点微薄的羞愧瞬间被底气取代。在他们看来，只要元始出面，便是天道正统出面，今日之事必有转机，他们的劫路、道途、性命，皆可重回正轨。
对面，多宝道人、赵公明、罗宣等截教核心金仙立身阵前，千万弟子分列两侧，阵纹锁海、道韵凝山，人人身姿挺拔、纹丝不退。
他们无需言语，无需争辩，千万道截天道韵齐齐共鸣，便是最硬的底气、最稳的立场。此地是金鳌岛，是截教万古祖庭，自家圣人坐镇此间，纵是玉清圣念亲临，也绝无退让臣服之理。
全场目光，尽数聚焦碧游宫。
等待截教圣人的回应，等待这场高位对峙的最终走向。
片刻沉寂之后，碧游宫深处终于传出一道淡然笑声，不急不躁、不卑不亢，穿透层层云海，隔空对上玉清圣念。
“师兄倒是好气派。”
通天圣音悠悠回荡，响彻天地，字字清晰、句句锋利，
“道祖立规，圣人不得亲自下场干涉洪荒凡间劫数、弟子纷争。师兄今日倒好，直接一缕神念入我金鳌岛，踏我山门、扰我道统、镇我门人。”
“这般行径，是师兄记性差了，还是如今的天道规矩，已然拦不住玉清行道？”
一句话，先立规矩、再占道理，当场将元始架在越界违规的位置上。

通天从一开始就不接“弟子归属、对错纷争”的话头，直接揪住最核心的规矩漏洞反击。
圣人博弈，从来不是比谁委屈、比谁有理，而是比谁站在大道制高点，谁能先锁死对方的失格之处。
云海之上，元始神念虚影微微一动，清冷圣音再度落下，毫无退让之意，反倒当场反咬一口。
“规矩为衡道而立，非为徇私护短所用。”
“寻常弟子缘法纷争，我自不会插手。可杨戬、哪吒二人，本是我玉虚门下天定嫡传，是我推演天机、锁定的应劫种子，专为化解十二金仙杀劫而生。”
“汝截教平日广收旁门、散纳万灵，我从未过问。可如今，汝竟敢直接截走我阐教天定弟子、断我阐教道统根基、绝我门下生机。
此等断道灭根之仇，我若再袖手旁观，便是放任截教乱天、坏尽玄门秩序！”
元始的话术，凌厉至极，层层递进、步步锁死。
他直接将一桩简单的收徒纷争，定性为截教蓄意破坏天道秩序、针对阐教道统、灭绝十二金仙的谋逆之举。
以“天意推演、天定嫡传、玄门正统”三重名分，牢牢锁住自身正当性，将自己越界干涉的行为，包装成被迫出手、维护天道的必然之举。
这一刻，他不是上门寻衅，是替天行道、扶正秩序。
碧游宫内，通天再度发笑，笑意冰冷，毫无半分暖意。
content_en:
In front of Jin'ao Island, the world is completely silent.
The Holy Thought of Yuqing spans the nine heavens, and the invisible and immaterial supreme pressure suppresses the entire sea and sky, freezing formations, condensing the immortal wind, and suppressing thousands of immortals. The Jie Jiao formation that was about to close up just now was hovering in mid-air, with all its murderous intentions blocked, and it was difficult to lose even half a point.
A ray of divine thought from Yuanshi Tianzun descended from the sky, and an indifferent holy shadow slowly condensed in the void, standing on the top of the sea of ​​clouds, just in front of the Twelve Golden Immortals of Chanjiao.
This figure is not complete, has no specific appearance, and has no majestic pressure to leak out, but it has the highest level of Yuqing orthodoxy and Xuanmen Taoism. Just standing quietly, it makes the entire Jin'ao Island dojo tremble slightly.
He first raised his eyes and scanned the bright giant statue in front of him. His eyes passed through the layers of green holy light, and finally fell into the silent depths of Biyou Palace.
He didn't get angry immediately or suddenly get angry, but he had a strong attitude of settling the matter.
Today's trip is not just to hold people accountable at will, but to thoroughly clarify the differences in orthodoxy, affiliation of disciples, and the right and wrong of God's will between the two sects that have been accumulated for many years, and to reach an irrefutable conclusion.
Below, the twelve golden immortals stood with their heads bowed, all silent.
After being washed away by Jie Tian Huaguang and clearing their minds, they had already understood that their actions were extremely out of bounds and they were wrong in the first place.
But the moment the saint's spiritual thoughts came, the little shame in my heart was instantly replaced by confidence. In their view, as long as Yuanshi comes forward, it means that the orthodoxy of heaven comes forward, and today's things will definitely turn around, and their calamity, path, and lives can all get back on track.
Opposite, Taoist Duobao, Zhao Gongming, Luo Xuan and other core golden immortals of the Jiejiao Cult stood in front of the formation. Thousands of disciples lined up on both sides.
There is no need for them to speak or argue. Thousands of words of Jie Tian Dao resonate in unison, which is the strongest confidence and the most stable stance. This place is Jin'ao Island, the eternal ancestral home of Jiejiao. Our own saints sit here. Even if Yuqing's Holy Thought comes in person, there is no reason to give in or surrender.
All the eyes of the audience were focused on Biyou Palace.
Waiting for the response from the Saint of Jiejiao, waiting for the final direction of this high-level confrontation.
After a moment of silence, a calm laughter finally came from the depths of Biyou Palace. It was neither impatient nor impatient, neither humble nor overbearing. It penetrated through the layers of clouds and met Yuqing's holy thoughts from the air.
"Senior brother is quite impressive."
The Holy Sound echoes long and full, resounding throughout the heaven and earth, with clear words and sharp sentences.
"The Taoist Ancestor has established a rule that saints are not allowed to personally interfere in the catastrophes of the ancient world and the disputes between disciples. Today is a good day for my senior brother. He directly sent a ray of spiritual thought into my Jin'ao Island, stepped on my mountain gate, disturbed my Taoism, and suppressed my disciples."
"Is this behavior due to senior brother's poor memory, or is it because today's laws of heaven can no longer stop Yuqing from practicing his way?"
In a word, establish the rules first and then apply the principles, putting Yuan Shi in the position of violating the rules and regulations on the spot.
From the beginning, Tongtian did not answer the question of "disciple ownership, disputes about right and wrong", and directly seized on the core loopholes in the rules to fight back.
The game of saints is never about who is aggrieved or justified, but about who stands on the commanding heights of the road and who can lock in the opponent's disqualification first.
Above the sea of ​​clouds, the phantom of Yuanshi's spiritual thoughts moved slightly, and the cold holy voice fell again. He had no intention of giving in, but instead bit back on the spot.
"Rules are established for the sake of balance, not for selfish ends."
"I will not intervene in the ordinary disputes between disciples. But Yang Jian and Nezha are the direct descendants of my Yuxu sect. They are the seeds of the disaster that I deduced from heaven and locked. They were born specifically to resolve the murder of the twelve golden immortals."
"Your Jie Sect usually recruits side disciples and disperses all souls, but I have never interfered. But now, you dare to directly intercept the Tianding disciples of my Chan Sect, cut off the foundation of my Chan Sect's Taoism, and eliminate the vitality of my sect.
If I continue to stand by and watch this kind of hatred that cuts off the Tao and destroys the roots, I will allow the Jiejiao to chaos and destroy the Taoist order! "
Yuanshi's words are extremely sharp, progressive and locked step by step.
He directly transferred a simpleShan's dispute over the recruitment of disciples was characterized as a treasonous move by Jiejiao to deliberately undermine the order of heaven, target the orthodoxy of Chanjiao, and exterminate the Twelve Golden Immortals.
With the triple status of "Deduction of God's Will, Direct Succession of Heaven, and Xuanmen Orthodoxy", he firmly locked his own legitimacy, and packaged his behavior of cross-border interference as an inevitable move that he was forced to take action to safeguard the way of heaven.
At this moment, he was not coming to pick a fight, but to uphold justice and restore order.
In Biyou Palace, Tongtian laughed again, his smile was cold and without any warmth at all.
